_schema.purpose: Penalty unit values by jurisdiction for fine calculation. Look up, multiply by the offence's prescribed units, and cite the effective date in the output.
rules: Apply the value in force at the date the offence was committed, not the sentencing date.
If value is null, or verified_as_at is more than 6 months old, web-verify against the source before use (SKILL.md section 3 hard currency rule).
Some jurisdictions (e.g. WA, SA) prescribe most WHS penalties as dollar amounts rather than penalty units; check the offence provision itself before assuming a penalty-unit calculation applies.

Several harmonised jurisdictions converted WHS Act penalties from dollar amounts to penalty units via post-2022 amendment Acts - confirm the offence provision's current expression in the consolidated Act.

CTH.indexation: CPI-indexed every 3 years from 1 July 2026 (Crimes Act 1914 (Cth) s 4AA(3))
CTH.source: Crimes Act 1914 (Cth) s 4AA; ACCC fines and penalties page

NSW.indexation: Fixed - not automatically indexed (Crimes (Sentencing Procedure) Act 1999 (NSW) s 17). Note: many NSW WHS Act penalties are expressed as CPI-indexed dollar amounts, not penalty units - check the provision.

VIC.indexation: Fixed annually by the Treasurer under the Monetary Units Act 2004 (Vic), effective 1 July.
VIC.source: Victoria Government Gazette No. S 234 (5 May 2026); Department of Justice and Community Safety Victoria

QLD.indexation: Indexed annually (default 3.5% unless the Treasurer sets otherwise) under the Penalties and Sentences Act 1992 (Qld) s 5A
QLD.source: Penalties and Sentences Act 1992 (Qld) s 5A; Qld Department of Local Government

WA.indexation: WA prescribes most WHS penalties as dollar amounts in the WHS Act 2020 (WA), not penalty units; penalty units exist for some other WA statutes.

SA.indexation: SA generally prescribes fines as dollar amounts (divisional or specified) rather than penalty units.

TAS.indexation: Indexed annually under the Penalty Units and Other Penalties Act 1987 (Tas), effective 1 July.
TAS.source: Penalty Units and Other Penalties Act 1987 (Tas)

ACT.indexation: Legislation Act 2001 (ACT) s 133; separate values for individuals and corporations - confirm both.

NT.indexation: Indexed annually under the Penalty Units Act 2009 (NT), effective 1 July.

NZ.indexation: Not applicable - NZ HSWA 2015 penalties are prescribed as dollar maxima in the Act (e.g. ss 47-49), not penalty units.
NZ.source: Health and Safety at Work Act 2015 (NZ)
